decisions.reason: The source narrows the audit deliverable to the Connector Module but does not change the product requirement for immediate deletion of persisted connector connections.
Narrowing the audit focus does not resolve or change whether account-member access revocation belongs in Release 1.
The source changes only the requested audit focus and packaging; it does not resolve or modify the Release 1 scope of account-member listing.
The request for a separate Connector Module assessment does not decide whether account-member removal is required for Release 1.
The audit-deliverable narrowing does not establish, remove, or otherwise change the scope of member invitation acceptance.
The source does not resolve whether an invitation landing route belongs in Release 1; it only narrows the assessment being requested.
Focusing the audit on the Connector Module does not decide whether owner-facing member usage limits belong in Release 1 or Phase 2.
The source modifies the audit task rather than the product scope and therefore does not resolve the owner-facing metering requirement's Release 1 versus Phase 2 ambiguity.
